mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect overcast skies around Verona Area High School with temperatures sitting at 57 degrees.

Cap off your day with a sweet treat at Culver's, where today's Flavor of the Day is Pumpkin Pecan. The location is open tonight until 10 PM.
